description:
Story
宮本武蔵の鯨退治

「宮本武蔵決闘の日」に江戸の浮世絵師「歌川国芳」の代表作「宮本武蔵の鯨退治」のデザインのミニ財布「小さいふ」が登場。

歌川国芳の浮世絵「宮本武蔵の鯨退治」は弘化4年-嘉永３年(1847-1850)の作品。宮本武蔵の人間を超越した強さによって、鯨を退治したという伝説に基づき描かれたものです。

伝説によると宮本武蔵は海を渡る途中、大きな鯨に遭遇します。その巨体と力強さで周囲を恐怖させていた鯨に立ち向かい、壮絶な闘いを繰り広げた武蔵は、その闘いの中で巧妙な戦術を駆使して、鯨を退治したと言われています。

話の出どころは不明とされていますが、剣豪「宮本武蔵」のその、現実離れした強さから数々の武勇伝が誕生したのはないでしょうか。

NHK Eテレの世界の「びじゅつ」を歌とアニメで紹介する「びじゅチューン！」の『武蔵の遅刻理由』では巌流島での佐々木小次郎との決闘に武蔵が遅刻したエピソードを交えて「宮本武蔵の鯨退治」を面白く紹介しています。

歌川国芳
Utagawa Kuniyoshi

1797-1861。江戸時代末期を代表する浮世絵師。江戸日本橋の染物屋の家に生まれ12歳の頃に描いた鍾馗図が初代歌川豊国の目に止まり、程なく豊国門に入る。20代は不遇の時を過ごすが、31歳の頃、「水滸伝」を題材にした「通俗水滸伝豪傑百八人之一個」を版行。これが人気を呼び、「武者絵の国芳」と称された。
役者絵や美人画、風景画、ユーモアあふれる戯画など幅広いジャンルを手掛け、中でも3枚続の構図の武者絵や歴史画は大衆の心をつかんだ。親分肌な人柄から落合芳幾、月岡芳年、河鍋暁斎ら多くの優秀な門人を集めた。

É AMANHÃ! 💖 Samba Summer Mix 2025 apresenta:
OFICINA DE AFROSAMBA com @egilioliveira

Egili Oliveira é atriz e professora de samba no pé. Artista premiada e conceituada em carnavais de todo o mundo, acumula os títulos de Rainha do Carnaval da Suécia; Madrinha do Carnaval da Finlândia; Rainha de bateria da União Parque Curicica; Rainha de bateria da GRES Vigário Geral, Musa da Renascer de Jacarepaguá e da São Clemente. 

 Viaja pelo mundo ministrando workshops de samba no pé, mas sem deixar de contemplar o Brasil, especialmente sua cidade, o Rio de Janeiro.

Desde de 2007 sendo uma das pioneiras em compartilhar a arte do samba em solos estrangeiros, atravessando fronteiras com nossa cultura, Egili é também idealizadora do projeto Samba Summer Mix e traz na construção de seu samba, o encontro consigo e com sua ancestralidade, a potência da mulher negra, da valorização de suas raízes. Esse encontro consigo mesma a fez querer compartilhar com outras mulheres o poder o samba, e foi assim que iniciou sua a ministrar aulas de AfroSamba, especialmente para crianças e adultas de comunidades próximas.

description:
I haven't written in a while- actually I have been writing a series of short heartbreaking poetry and quotes but I haven't been sharing here. Yhep, guilty of gatekeeping sad words.

Okay now this post!

I sat with my cutter in one hand and the pencil in the other, musing. It suddenly struck me how loyal they are to each other, where you see a sharpened pencil, there's always a blade behind it's point. Where you see a blunt cutter, it's from it's loyal service to the pencil. 

"But the pencil breaks, and the cutter gets blunt"
- @ibrahim_abdull

"But never by the other, the cutter always finds it's way back to the pencil, the cutter gets blunt; sharpening the pencil and the pencil always comes back to the cutter after being broken by others"
-buzuwa

"The cutter is always hacking on the pencil, wounding it, but not to flaw it, instead to shape it into perfection"
-buzuwa

Now here's another way to look at it!!!

The depth in these are undebatable. I hope every pencil finds a cutter.

.

.

.

.

JULY 1ST: Sick of ICE? Call out sick! 

Rhode Island joins the country in a massive wave of protest where working people will refuse to go to work. Instead, we’re calling on all people, especially citizens, to:

- Support immigrant street vendors and small businesses
- Go to a march, community event or meet-up
- Donate to an organization taking action or providing emergency relief for immigrant families
- Join the RI Deportation Defense Network
- Post messages and videos explaining why you’re participating

That evening, you’re invited to a block party in Central Falls! 

🎊 Celebrate Immigrants – an Anti-ICE Block Party
📅 Tuesday, July 1st at 6PM
📍 Dexter Plaza – 741 Dexter St., Central Falls, RI

Stand with our immigrant communities — we want ICE out!

Any future act of terror by Pakistan will be considered an act of war, and India will respond accordingly, sources said today.

The announcement of the new rules of engagement against terror with cross-border linkages comes two weeks after Pakistan-linked terrorists killed 26 tourists in Jammu and Kashmir’s Pahalgam.

In response, while India launched precision cruise missile strikes at terror infrastructure in Pakistan and Pakistan-Occupied Jammu and Kashmir (PoJK), the neighbouring country where the military has a strong grip on the civilian government escalated the situation by attacking civilian areas in India with drones.

description:
Some of the linens I painted/drew/sewed and sold at Cherry Creek last weekend. About half of them were embroidered- something I only have the patience for when I truly need a break from painting! Looking forward to taking a little break from the studio soon. It’s been such a busy couple of years with non-stop show deadlines… time to get outside and recharge for a little bit. I do think of creativity as a finite resource, a wellspring that must be re-filled at times. Spending time outside, observing and meditating on the miracle of beauty and what the hell it all means, far from home if possible, usually does the trick :)

കോച്ചിംഗ് സെൻ്ററിൽ വെള്ളംക‌യറിയുണ്ടായ ദുരന്തം; മരിച്ചവരിൽ എറണാകുളം സ്വദേശിയും

ന്യൂ​ഡ​ൽ​ഹി: രാ​ജ്യ​ത​ല​സ്ഥാ​ന​ത്ത് സി​വി​ൽ സ​ർ​വീ​സ് പ​രി​ശീ​ല​ന​കേ​ന്ദ്ര​ത്തി​ൽ വെ​ള്ളം ക​യ​റി​യ​തി​നെ തു​ട​ർ​ന്ന് മു​ങ്ങി​മ​രി​ച്ച​വ​രി​ല്‍ ഒ​രാ​ള്‍ മ​ല​യാ​ളി​യെ​ന്ന് സ്ഥി​രീ​ക​ര​ണം. എ​റ​ണാ​കു​ളം സ്വ​ദേ​ശി ന​വീ​ന്‍ ഡാ​ല്‍​വി​ന്‍ ആ​ണ് മ​രി​ച്ച​ത്. ജെ​എ​ന്‍​യു​വി​ലെ ഗ​വേ​ഷ​ക വി​ദ്യാ​ര്‍​ഥി​യാ​ണ് ന​വീ​ന്‍.

ഡ​ൽ​ഹി ഓ​ൾ​ഡ് രാ​ജീ​ന്ദ്ര ന​ഗ​റി​ലെ സി​വി​ൽ സ​ർ​വീ​സ് പ​രി​ശീ​ല​ന​കേ​ന്ദ്ര​ത്തി​ലാ​ണ് വെ​ള്ളം ക​യ​റി മൂ​ന്ന് വി​ദ്യാ​ർ​ഥി​ക​ൾ മു​ങ്ങി​മ​രി​ച്ച​ത്. ക​ന​ത്ത മ​ഴ​യി​ല്‍ സ്ഥാ​പ​ന​ത്തി​ന്‍റെ മു​ന്നി​ലെ റോ​ഡി​ൽ മു​ഴു​വ​ൻ വെ​ള്ളം നി​റ​ഞ്ഞി​രു​ന്നു.

കെ​ട്ടി​ട​ത്തി​ന്‍റെ താ​ഴ​ത്തെ നി​ല​യി​ലേ​ക്ക് വെ​ള്ളം കു​ത്തി​യൊ​ലി​ച്ച് എ​ത്തു​ക​യാ​യി​രു​ന്നു. മ​രി​ച്ച വി​ദ്യാ​ർ​ഥി​ക​ളു​ടെ മൃ​ത​ദേ​ഹങ്ങൾ ആ​ശു​പ​ത്രി​യി​ലേ​ക്ക് മാ​റ്റി.

description:
OUR TEACHERS ROCK! This week is Teacher Appreciation Week and over the course of the week, we’re highlighting the amazing teachers who we named earlier this school year as our Teachers of the Year! Next up is Aysha Berry of Washington-Henry Elementary School!

Ms. Berry is a fourth grade teacher and has been an educator for three years. She said she loves teaching because “I love to watch my students grow and build meaningful student-teacher relationships to help them be successful!”

What does it mean to be teacher of the year for Washington-Henry Elementary School?

“To be Teacher of the Year means gaining the trust from my students, our families, and my team at WHES. The trust is to know that I lead my students with grace and a strong effort. I know that I was meant to be a teacher because of my determination and I really instill that into my students. Being a teacher shows the impact we have on shaping the future for our young students. My goal is to build a classroom community where students not only learn, but feel loved, welcomed, empowered, and inspired. Knowing that I was awarded this title continues to show my commitment to this field but also to the success of my students and colleagues.”

She added: “'Never let the fear of striking out keep you from playing the game.' - Babe Ruth”

Congratulations, Ms. Berry, and thank you for your dedication to our students!

 #InspireEmpowerLead #HanoverStrong #ATraditionOfExcellence

A Polícia Militar apreendeu um Jeep Compass clonado na segunda-feira, 3 de fevereiro, após receber denúncias anônimas.

O veículo estava estacionado em uma garagem na Rua José Costa Marques, no Bairro Industrial em Ubá MG. Após verificação, descobriu-se que o veículo original pertencia a um proprietário de outro estado, que confirmou estar com seu automóvel na garagem.

A vistoria minuciosa revelou que o Jeep havia sido roubado em São Paulo em 2021. No momento da diligência, a residência estava vazia e ninguém foi preso. No entanto, a responsável pelo aluguel do imóvel será investigada pela Polícia Civil. [REENCUENTRO] Máximo Napa, el pescador peruano que desapareció en diciembre de 2024. Después de 95 días a la deriva, fue encontrado a cientos de millas del mar ecuatoriano por una embarcación atunera que lo localizó gracias a gaviotas que volaban en círculos sobre su bote.

La tripulación del barco atunero, al notar el inusual comportamiento de las aves, se acercó y descubrió a Napa con signos visibles de desgaste, pero increíblemente con vida. 

Tras su rescate, Napa fue trasladado a la Base Naval de Paita, donde recibió los primeros cuidados médicos antes de reencontrarse con su familia. Al ver a su hermano Alberto, ambos no pudieron contener las lágrimas. "Pensé que nunca más lo volvería a ver, esto es un regalo de Dios", expresó su hermano entre sollozos.

Los médicos evaluarán su estado de salud antes de su traslado a Pisco, Ica, donde lo espera el resto de su familia.

EMERGENCY CALL TO ACTION

Our community is under threat. ICE is active in Sonoma County, targeting immigrants, separating families, and spreading fear. We will not sit back in silence.

Join us for an emergency protest to stand up, speak out, and demand justice. Our voices and presence are urgently needed.

Location: Old Courthouse Square, Santa Rosa
Date: Wednesday, June 11
Time: 5:00 PM
Meeting Point: By the Unity Statue

This is a moment to show up for our neighbors and to fight for a county where everyone is safe and protected, regardless of status. Bring your signs, your voice, and your solidarity.

El sector agropecuario ha mantenido, y tal vez aumentado, su importancia en la economía del país. Basta solamente con ver que para el Producto Interno Bruto (PIB) del tercer trimestre del año representó 9,8% del PIB total, con un crecimiento de 2,4% y un aporte de $46,8 billones para confirmarlo.⁠
⁠
Con esto en mente, se hace cada vez más evidente por trabajar en el agro, en sus negocios y en su desempeño en términos de tecnología y sostenibilidad, siendo cada vez más atractivo para nuevas generaciones, y abriendo espacios para aspectos que en el pasado no se abordaron. De esta manera han nacido muchos negocios, cada uno enfocado en sus aspectos.⁠

description:
So it's 2022 .

In 2021 in had the fantastic opportunity to share a head of my knowledge with you lovely folk. 

And even more so with my clients both in person and online. 

How did it go? ....

Absolutely great! 
We focused 
We focused hard. 

What I saw, as in there other years of coaching people were some similar behaviours . 

I OFTEN WONDER WHY WE DO IT ! 

I spent so much time in the last 12 months teaching people the following as well as re -learning and re practicing these things myself. 

1. If the plan sucks dick... you probably won't stick to it for long. 

2. Don't set yourself on fire to keep other people warm.

3.people don't have to understand YOUR Goals. 

4. Slow and steady wins the race- Rome was not built in a day 

5. I love that saying as it's such a beautiful place .

6. Don't judge others it's not always there fault .

7. Don't worry about others opinions . 

8. Control what you can control 

9. Focus on living for love and happiness... not purchases and possessions. 

10. Share what you are passionate about .

11. Love the person you see in the mirror.

12. You have so much to offer yourself and others . 

13. Focus on health... not a size, shape or weight. 

14. Give some one your time ... its the best gift you can give. 

15. Be the person you always wanted to be, don't apologise for being that person... be a dreamer, be a beliver, be an optimist . 

Live as much life as you can in every second .

Let's go 2022.

description:
YES, candles may cause headaches for some people. I'm tired of seeing candle companies B.S.-ing you saying "our candles won't cause headaches" just to get some $$ 🙄⁠
⁠
A lot of fragrance used in candles often have harsh synthetic chemicals in them that can trigger migraines and brain fog. Headaches may also be triggered if an aroma is overpowering. You know, like when an aroma is so thick in the air it's like you can cut it with a knife? Gross 🤮⁠
⁠
While I can't promise that my candles won't trigger headaches, I can guarantee that they are free of harsh chemicals. I also offer tea light candle samples on PaigesCandleCo.com that allows you to smell up to 10 different aromas in a small candle size before committing to a larger size. This enables you to sample aromas and see if you like them 🥰⁠
⁠
Remember, If you notice that scented candles consistently trigger headaches for you, it might be a good idea to avoid them in general. Proper ventilation can also help minimize the concentration of fragrance in the air. MANIFESTAÇÃO ACABA EM AGRESSÃO POLICIAL

Moradores do bairro de São Marcos, em Salvador, denunciaram na noite desta quinta-feira (10) uma agressão policial durante uma manifestação. O protesto era motivado pela morte de Caíque dos Santos Reis, que, de acordo com familiares, teria sido assassinado durante uma ação anterior da Polícia Militar no bairro.

Vídeos que circulam nas redes sociais mostram o momento em que um policial desfere um tapa que atinge o celular de um morador que estava gravando a ação dos agentes. Outras imagens mostram manifestantes reclamando das agressões enquanto afirmam que apenas buscavam justiça pela morte de Caíque.

The Grand Mosque of Paris, also known as the Great Mosque of Paris is a #historic spectacle of architectural grandeur 😍

Renowned for its #historical significance, when the Nazis occupied Paris, no Jew was safe from arrest and deportation. Yet during that perilous time, many Jews found refuge in an unlikely place—the sprawling complex of the Grand Mosque of Paris. Not just a place of worship but a community center, this hive of activity was an ideal temporary hiding place for escaped prisoners of war and Jews of all ages, especially children. 🙌🏻

description:
No ano que tivemos que superar muitas adversidades, também foi ano de implementar novos projetos que causassem impacto e promovessem mudança na vida das pessoas. E o Entre Elas foi um desses projetos! 

Quando muito se discutia sobre a falta de acesso a produtos básicos de higiene pessoal para as meninas e mulheres de baixa renda, em São Vicente era criamos o 'Entre Elas', justamente para ajudar e dar mais dignidade para elas!

Secretaria de Saúde, Educação, Desenvolvimento Social, Comunicação e o Fundo Social, todos envolvidos juntos da comunidade vicentina para arrecadar absorventes para as meninas das nossas escolas e para promover encontros para debatermos juntos um tema tão importante como é a pobreza menstrual.

Eu, como homem, me emocionei em um desses encontros ao ouvir alguns relatos e saber o quanto o projeto ajudou na vida dessas meninas, e que bom que a gente teve a oportunidade de trazer um tema tão importante e debater dentro das nossas escolas.

É entre elas, para elas, por todas elas! ❤️

description:
網民都睇唔過眼！

不少人都鍾意影相拍片紀錄生活，部分人更將影片上傳至社交平台與他人分享。但如果拍片為了流量而整蠱人，確實容易引起爭議。近日有網民就發現兩名港女故意拍片嚇醒保安伯伯，更自以為有趣大肆share，引來大批網民鬧爆！

由這段受爭議的影片可見，兩名港女正「玩遊戲」，二人先猜包剪揼決定誰人需要接受「懲罰」，第一輪「輸咗去同個瞓着咗嘅看更影相」，惟「影相嗰陣同個看更隔九仗遠」，因此出現第二輪懲罰，「大力拍落道閘叫醒個看更」。有網民發現後，即時轉載相關影片以示不滿。

兩名港女在影片中笑得好開心，但網民就睇唔過眼，怒斥「呢啲人到底咩心態？」、「拍個鐵閘嚇到個阿伯」、「然後仲笑得咁開心，post出嚟以為自己好搞笑？」，更揚言「要玩都唔應該玩呢啲嘢囉」。

除了轉載的網民，其他人亦留言表示片中人「心地又差又無腦」、「又係啲bully完人話『玩下咋嘛』嗰啲人」。片主事後亦有現身回應，坦言「喺呢度想為我同朋友幼稚及衝動嘅行為道歉，我哋當時冇諗後果，因為貪玩去做啲有機會發生危險嘅事」，又承諾「之後會注意好一言一行，並會喺颱風後去返現場搵看更叔叔道歉」。

เปิดศักราช 2568 มา สมรภูมิร้านอาหาร ไม่ว่าจะปิ้งย่าง ชาบู หรือสุกี้ ถือว่าดุเดือดเป็นอย่างมาก แต่ละแบรนด์ต่างชูเรื่องของ “ราคา” และ “ความคุ้ม” มาห้ำหั่นกันอย่างเต็มที่
.
แต่ท่ามกลางเสียงเชียร์ของโปรโมชันลด แลก แจก แถม มีแบรนด์หนึ่งกลับเลือกยืนในจุดที่แตกต่างอย่างมั่นใจ นั่นคือ “บาร์บีคิวพลาซ่า” ผู้คร่ำหวอดในตลาดมากว่า 38 ปี หรือสัญลักษณ์ของร้านอย่าง “พี่ GON” ที่คนไทยคุ้นเคยกันดี
.

และแคมเปญล่าสุด “GON BUFFET ตั้งเตารอ คุ้มตาแตก” ก็ได้กลายเป็นหมากกลยุทธ์ที่พิสูจน์ให้เห็นว่า หากแบรนด์เข้าใจลูกค้าจริง ๆ ก็สามารถสร้างความหมายใหม่ให้กับคำว่าบุฟเฟต์ได้

El PP de Castellar ha fet un comunicat per recordar que des de fa tres mesos que es va cremar una part del Castell recreatiu a la plaça de la Fàbrica Nova encara no s’ha substituït el joc. La presidenta local dels populars, Alicia Garcia, ha qualificat aquest fet de “deixadesa” per part del consistori.

En aquest sentit, des de l’Ajuntament responen que encara hi ha tràmits pendents amb l’asseguradora que cobreix aquest tipus d’incidents i, per tant, de moment no es pot intervenir en la reposició del joc incendiat. Val a dir que la despesa que comporta instal·lar novament el Castell malmès ronda els 70.000 euros, assenyalen des de l’Ajuntament i, per tant, caldrà esperar a veure com es resol la qüestió amb l’asseguradora.

เวลา 12.22 น. วันที่ 14 กรกฎาคม 2568 รับแจ้งจาก กู้ภัยสยามบุรีรัมย์ มีอุบัติเหตุรถจักรยานยนต์ชนกับรถบรรทุก และมีผู้เสียชีวิต บนถนนทางหลวงชนบท บริเวณใกล้เคียงโรงเรียนทุ่งใหญ่ ต.ทุ่งแสงทอง อ.นางรอง จ.บุรีรัมย์

ที่เกิดเหตุ พบรถจักรยานยนต์ ยามาฮ่า สปาร์ค สีน้ำเงิน ไม่พบป้ายทะเบียน ลักษณะชนกับรถ 6 ล้อ สีขาว ป้ายทะเบียน บุรีรัมย์ แล้วถูกทับร่างซ้ำ ใกล้กันพบร่างของผู้เสียชีวิต 1 ราย ตรวจสอบเอกสาร เป็นชายไทย อายุ 62 ปี ในส่วนของสาเหตุอยู่ระหว่างการสอบสวนของเจ้าหน้าที่ตำรวจ สภ.นางรอง

description:
Babygirl opens today!

Picture this: A high-powered CEO, played by the Nicole Kidman, meets her match in a mischievous young intern (hello, Harris Dickinson), and suddenly, her carefully controlled life starts to unravel in the most deliciously chaotic way.

In Babygirl, Romy has it all — the career, the family, the perfect image — but behind closed doors? Let’s just say, her marriage is less fireworks and more… well, silent sparklers. Enter Samuel, the audacious intern who’s here to challenge everything she thought she knew about control, desire, and letting go.

Directed by Halina Reijn, this wickedly funny, tender, and unexpectedly romantic film dives deep into repressed desires, shifting power dynamics, and the messy, thrilling places they can lead us. Think: the sexy tension of a ’90s thriller but with all the modern feels.

Catch Babygirl in cinemas starting today, Friday, 27 December. Trust us, this is one movie you won’t want to miss.

Na manhã deste sábado (01), um automóvel com queixa de roubo foi recuperado pela guarnição RP 01 da Polícia Militar em Palmeira dos Índios, Alagoas. O fato ocorreu na Rua Radialista Antônio Martins, no bairro Juca Sampaio, próximo à Escola Municipal Vera Lúcia Gama Moura.

De acordo com informações divulgadas pelo 10° Batalhão de Polícia Militar (10º BPM), a guarnição foi acionada via COPOM para averiguar a presença de um veículo abandonado no local. Ao chegar, os militares encontraram um automóvel da marca Caoa Chery, modelo Tiggo 8 1.6 TGDI, ano 2022, com a chave na ignição e as portas abertas.

Diante da situação, os agentes consultaram o sistema INFOSEG, constatando que o carro possuía registro de roubo ou furto. O veículo foi então conduzido ao Centro Integrado de Segurança Pública (CISP) de Palmeira dos Índios e entregue à Polícia Civil, onde foi lavrado o boletim de ocorrência e adotadas as medidas cabíveis.

O caso foi registrado às 09h47, e a recuperação do automóvel representa mais uma ação eficaz da segurança pública no combate ao crime na região.

Jeshi la Polisi mkoani Tabora linamshikilia Ofisa Habari wa Klabu ya Yanga, Ali Kamwe.

Akizungumza na Mwananchi Digital leo Alhamisi Aprili 3,2025, Kamanda wa Polisi Mkoa wa Tabora, Richard Abwao amethibitisha jeshi hilo kumshikilia Kamwe huku akitaja sababu kuwa ni kauli chafu kwa viongozi wa Serikali.

“Ndio tunamshikilia Ally Kamwe na tunaendelea na mahojiano na taratibu nyingine zitaendelea kwa mujibu wa sheria,"amesema Abwao.

Kamwe anashikiliwa ikiwa ni siku mbili zipite tangu arushe dongo kwa Mkuu wa Mkoa wa Tabora, Paul Chacha katika hamasa kuelekea mchezo wao dhidi ya Tabora United uliomalizika jana Aprili 2, 2025 kwa Yanga kushinda bao 3-0.

Katika video inayosambaa mitandaoni inamuonyesha Kamwe akiwa mkoani Tabora akifanya hamasa ya mchezo huo huku akisema: “Kuna watu wanatafuta kiki..mkuu wa mkoa nani huyu, Chacha eenh? Atachacha kweli baada ya mechi,”

Chanzo cha Kamwe kusema hivyo ni kutokana na mkuu wa mkoa kuahidi Tabora United endapo itamfunga Yanga itapewa bonansi ya Sh60 milioni huku pia akishutumu watu wa Yanga kuwatumia meseji za rushwa wachezaji wa Tabora.

#8Ene | 🇨🇴 Petro confirmó que no asistirá a la toma de posesión presidencial en Venezuela tras detenciones de activistas en el país

Gustavo Petro, presidente de Colombia, confirmó el 8 de enero que no asistirá a la toma de posesión presidencial en Venezuela, luego de que se conociera la detención del dirigente político Enrique Márquez y el activista de derechos humanos Carlos Correa.

“Esto, y otros hechos, impide mi asistencia personal al acto de posesión de Nicolás Maduro”, escribió Petro en su cuenta de X. 

El mandatario colombiano aseveró que la solicitud de “máxima transparencia en las elecciones” por parte de su gobierno no fue atendida por las autoridades venezolanas.

“Las elecciones pasadas en Venezuela no fueron libres. No hay elecciones libres bajo bloqueos”, expresó. 

👉 Desestimó romper relaciones con Venezuela 

Petro desestimó la posibilidad de romper relaciones con Venezuela. Asimismo, alegó que no se cerrarán las fronteras ni su gobierno intervendrá en los asuntos internos de la nación vecina. 

“El gobierno colombiano entiende que nuestros dos pueblos están ligados por sangre, cultura e historia, y que cerrar fronteras, evitar el relacionamiento diplomático y separar nuestros pueblos a la fuerza es de una brutalidad enorme. Lleva a que las fronteras sean de las mafias, y se provoca el hambre de millones de seres humanos colombianos y venezolanos y su éxodo, y a la violación sistemática de sus derechos humanos”, expresó.

El mandatario instó a que se respeten los derechos humanos de todos los venezolanos. También invitó a que haya un diálogo interno en Venezuela y aseguró que su gobierno mantendrá una posición de amistad y colaboración con el Estado venezolanos. 

También pidió la liberación de los presos políticos en Venezuela. “Solicitamos la libertad de todas las personas detenidas por razones políticas”.

description:
Una mujer en Corea se niega a comer carne. Otra mujer en Delaware no quiere salir de una piscina. En los dos casos, lo importante no es el acto en sí, sino la subversión a la norma, el rechazo a las reglas impuestas, al matrimonio, a las convenciones sociales. Lo importante es que no hay marcha atrás. Que han empezado su revolución. 

“Golpe magistral”, de Jessica Anthony, me ha recordado a “La vegetariana”, de Han Kang, aunque es menos violento y se enmarca más en el fin del sueño americano. Unos idílicos apartamentos en una tranquila zona residencial. Maridos que juegan al golf. Mujeres que hacen pastel de carne. Y una piscina de aguas turquesas que nadie usa. Pero la misma premisa, dos mujeres que, un buen día, hacen lo que nadie espera de ellas. Un acto que desentona completamente con su papel de esposas abnegadas. Y lo más importante, la negativa a volver al buen camino, a “entrar en razón”. Y sus pobres maridos, dignos de compasión, se han casados con "mujeres histéricas", ellos no lo merecen, dirán los vecinos asomados a los balcones. Y poco a poco, se irá desentrañando la realidad tras la patina de cotidianidad, tras la mujer que espera pacientemente a que su marido llegue a casa de trabajar. Y por su puesto, te pones de parte de ellas. No salir de la piscina, no comer carne, decir no a las normas, a las culpas, a los deseos de otros. Romper las cadenas con un sencillo acto que esconde toda una rebelión.

Architectural Education in Focus: FIU Hosts Advisory Board Meeting for Quality Assessment
———————————————
As part of its ongoing commitment to academic excellence and continuous improvement, the Faculty of Architecture at Final International University held an Advisory Board Meeting on June 25, 2025, under the chairmanship of Prof. Dr. Haan Ali Bıçak.
The Advisory Board is composed of distinguished professionals including Hakkı Atun, Tunç Adanır, Doğan Sahir, Deniz Kolozali, Ekrem Bodamyalızade, and Hasan Zafersoy. All members have previously lectured in schools of architecture and most have served as past presidents of the Chamber of Architects of KTMMOB.

Representing the Faculty of Architecture and Fine Arts, Dean Prof. Dr. Zeynep Üstün Onur, Vice Dean Assoc. Prof. Dr. Aminreza Iranmanesh, Head of Department Asst. Prof. Dr. Pooya Lotfabadi, and Asst. Prof. Dr. Rasiha Kayalar were in attendance.
The meeting began with a presentation by Assoc. Prof. Dr. Iranmanesh, outlining the department’s program learning outcomes and extracurricular activities. This was followed by valuable contributions from the advisory board members, who shared their insights and professional experiences, offering recommendations on the essential qualities and competencies needed to educate the architects of tomorrow.

description:
Who’s ready for new @fibremood patterns?!! 

This is the #fibremoodfausta pleated skirt with side zipper. I’ve wanted a white midi skirt all summer and finally made it happen with this pattern. I used @stylemakerfabrics washed crinkle cotton (totally obsessed). 

It’s a timeless pleated skirt that can be dressed up or down, depending on how you style it. I made mine in size 6. Be mindful of which size you pick because it’s very difficult to modify the size once completed. 
A muslin would be a great idea!

Sewing tips-
The instructions have you match the hem pleats first, but I had an easier time matching and simultaneously pinning (vertically) the top, middle, and bottom pleat marks. Then, I ironed the whole skirt flat. 

Overall, the pattern can be tackled by an intermediate sewist. The skirt is beautiful, and I can't wait to make more!! 

The top is from @madewell 

#fibremood #linkpartyed30 #isew #sewist #sew #sewingpattern #sewing #stylemakerfabrics

description:
【Yahoo娛樂圈報道】向太激罕談及細仔向佑與向佐分別 活半世紀才明：慈母多敗兒
向華強與太太陳嵐（向太）育有兩子向佐和向佑，向佐活躍於演藝圈，向佑則甚少被提及。日前，向太拍片罕有開腔談到細仔向佑，坦言：「他是我的痛」，並感嘆自己晚年先真正明白「慈母多敗兒」呢句說話：「我評論下面多少人問我，為什麼不提向佑，他是我的痛，慈母多敗兒，這句話我到50多歲才明白，我真的很後悔，所以今天就敞開來講吧。」

向太於影片中透露，雖然向佑自小覺得媽媽偏心哥哥向佐，但佢強調對兩子一視同仁，無論游泳或網球都安排最好嘅教練培訓，但最終向佐成績優異獲冠軍，向佑則混水摸魚，並且控制唔到脾氣，經常靠打人，甚至曾打計程車司機，打完對方之後仲當眾炫耀：「你知不知道我爸爸是誰」，並揚言爸爸係「全港最大社團龍頭大哥」，因襲擊並恐嚇司機於2016年被法庭裁定襲擊致造成身體傷害、刑事恐嚇及普通襲擊等三項罪名成立，被判入獄6個月：「你說他到底是天才，還是白癡呢。」向太續提及向佐與向佑分別，表示大約喺2000年左右，向太送兩兄弟到英國讀書，唔同嘅係向佑每月電話費高達兩萬元，卻一個電話都冇跟父母聯繫，反倒向佐只花兩千元，而電話都係打畀媽媽。向太苦笑指向佑根本唔會理你：「他生日，你打給他說生日快樂，他都不聽你的，不要說你生日，你別指望他打給你，可是每個月還要付兩萬多元他的電話費，他爸都不知道。」又指除咗開口要錢時，就會聽到向佑好聲好氣：「他回來要錢的時候他很會哄你，什麼都答應你，你講他說不可以這樣不可以那樣，（他說）好的好的，媽媽我一定會改，甚麼都答應你，拿完錢走完就轉頭就忘了，可是總是自己兒子，老是採取原諒原諒，其實原諒等於放縱，每次再跟你講個好話，你就想算了算了，又給他錢，就養他是個大懶蟲，反正沒錢回家拿就好了。」

向太表示向佑於獄中識咗唔少有背景人士，出獄後宣稱要去上海與某集團老闆談地產，令佢大感驚訝，質疑兒子：「你懂什麼？」而雖然向太讚兒子有繪畫天分，但向佑不願追藝術，堅持做生意，佢多次幫助向佑投資寵物店、餐廳，卻皆以失敗收場，向太無奈感嘆，兒子唔肯努力，只想一朝發達，認為自己好聰明。對此，向太直言後悔過度放任向佑，反思應該嚴格管教、唔應該隨意畀錢兒子，令佢變本加厲：「應該打他就不給他錢，看你乖不乖，就一毛錢都不要給。現在來不及了，而且他說我們敢不給他，他去借，敢威脅我們了。」向太語重心長表示：「我們做父母呢，就算你用了心了盡了力了，幫他想了很多辦法，希望他成材，給了很多錢，沒用的，不成材就是不成材。」並且提醒即使家境富裕，都唔應該寵壞孩子，對有創業夢嘅子女，父母只能提供一筆創業基金，普通家庭更應教導孩子大學畢業後自力更生：「千萬不要像我一樣，我們就是給太多錢了，就寵壞了，他認為太容易了，回來講講好話就給，唉！到頭來這樣，我為什麼50多歲才明白，太晚了，所以奉勸大家，千萬不要走我的老路。」

description:
O Grupo de Trabalho (GT) Capixaba sobre Psicologia, Maconha e Psicodélicos do CRP-16 convida a categoria a dialogar sobre seus conhecimentos frente ao uso da maconha e dos psicodélicos em diferentes contextos no Brasil.

O mapeamento tem como objetivo contribuir com as ações de orientação à categoria relacionadas à pauta de maconha e psicodélicos, destacando aspectos éticos, técnicos e científicos em relação à temática, bem como as possibilidades e os principais desafios para o exercício profissional na área.

Os dados coletados serão acessados exclusivamente pela equipe de pesquisa vinculada ao Conselho Regional de Psicologia do Espírito Santo (CRP-16), responsável pela organização do mapeamento. Os dados serão analisados de forma agrupada e anônima, e nenhuma informação individual identificável será divulgada.

Para participar, acesso o formulário digital no site do CRP-16 (link da bio). 

Saiba mais sobre o GT
O GT nasceu de uma articulação de psicólogas/os capixabas, que atuam em diferentes âmbitos, inclusive com pesquisas acadêmicas na Ufes e com a política de redução de danos. Esses profissionais procuraram o CRP-16, e o VII Plenário do Conselho deliberou pela criação do GT em âmbito institucional.

Vinculado ao CRP-16, o GT vai fomentar a discussão no Estado, estando alinhado a uma deliberação da Assembleia de Políticas da Administração e das Finanças (APAF) do Sistema Conselhos de Psicologia.

A Apaf criou um GT (do Conselho Federal de Psicologia) homônimo ao grupo de trabalho no ES para promover um congresso e subsidiar o debate nos Conselhos Regionais.

Os trabalhos devem acontecer na perspectiva da criação de políticas públicas sempre observando a ética, o cuidado integral e interdisciplinar, visando levar a temática para além do contexto biomédico.

A matéria completa sobre o GT também está disponível no link da bio. Já no YouTube do Conselho, você pode assistir à live do GT, realizada no dia 28 de junho.

*Contém texto alternativo.

Doupov se proměnil v Litevskou republiku. Vojákům simuloval prostředí v zahraniční operaci.⚔ Naše příprava do mise finišuje. Máme za sebou další důležité cvičení!👍
Cvičení na Doupově následovalo po certifikaci jednotky, jež tvoří jádro kontingentu. Certifikace se uskutečnila v dubnu v jihočeských Boleticích a proběhla striktně podle náročné alianční metodiky. „Oproti cvičení, které se uskutečnilo minulý měsíc, bylo toto odborně taktické cvičení zaměřené na sladění celého úkolového uskupení, včetně velení a štábu, které zabezpečují běžnou činnost na základně, ale i bojovou činnost samotné jednotky. Cvičení mělo za úkol simulovat běžný život a možné problémy, které mohou jednotku potkat v rámci nasazení na litevské základně Rukla i mimo ni,“ uvedl podplukovník Jaroslav Sekanina ke cvičení, jež proběhlo minulý týden ve vojenském výcvikovém prostoru Hradiště na Karlovarsku.

description:
Um homem de 54 anos, que havia sido preso preventivamente na última quinta-feira (26) sob a acusação de estuprar a própria filha e a neta de 6 anos, foi encontrado morto neste domingo (29) no Presídio Regional de Joinville. Ele estava detido por crimes de violência intrafamiliar enquanto as investigações prosseguiam.

A Polícia Civil confirmou que o indivíduo era investigado por abusos cometidos contra a filha, hoje com 26 anos, que relatou ter sido vítima de violência por mais de dez anos e engravidou duas vezes em decorrência dos crimes. A investigação também aponta que a neta, de apenas 6 anos, havia sido abusada.

O caso veio à tona após uma denúncia do Conselho Tutelar, acionado pela escola da criança de 6 anos. Educadores notaram comportamentos que levantaram suspeitas de abusos. A mãe da menina, procurada pelo órgão, decidiu então relatar a década de violência que sofria nas mãos do próprio pai.

As investigações revelaram um cenário de controle extremo, medo e silenciamento. A casa onde viviam não possuía portas internas e era equipada com câmeras para vigiar a rotina da filha. Ela também era submetida a privações de comida como forma de coerção.

O homem confessou parte dos crimes. De acordo com a administração prisional, o homem tirou a própria vida dentro da cela. Apesar da morte do suspeito, as investigações prosseguem. O material genético da criança será colhido para apurar a paternidade e confirmar se o agressor, de fato, engravidou a própria filha.

A vítima e a criança estão sob proteção, e a Polícia Civil continua a apurar detalhes do caso, buscando descobrir se outros familiares tinham conhecimento das agressões sofridas ao longo dos anos.

Tonight’s the night: Mozambique’s Ghorwane, our very own legendary band, celebrates 42 years with BCI’s support – you won’t want to miss this concert! 

#Mozambique #Moçambique #BCI #Ghorwane #MusicBand #ConcertNight #Anniversary #MozambiqueNews @bci_daqui @ghorwane.bonsrapazes 

BCI is joining the celebrations marking 42 years of the band Ghorwane’s career, one of Mozambique’s most iconic and influential musical groups. The commemorative concert will take place this Friday, 5 December, at 8:00 pm at the Franco-Mozambican Cultural Centre (CCFM) in Maputo, bringing to a distinguished close the cycle of celebrations that began in the same venue in 2024.

This information was shared during a press conference held on Thursday, 4 December, at BCI’s Auditorium, attended by Roberto Chitsonzo, lead vocalist, and Carlos Gove, bassist and musical director of Ghorwane.

On the occasion, BCI’s Administrator, Rogério Lam, highlighted the group’s significance in the national artistic landscape. “Speaking of Ghorwane is to evoke more than 40 years of history and to recognise one of Mozambique’s most emblematic bands. Ghorwane is not just a band; it is a living heritage of our culture,” he stated.

He also emphasised that the group’s unique musical identity, marked by a fusion of traditional rhythms, African influences and contemporary sounds, aligns with BCI’s vision of valuing national culture and continuously supporting the arts. “Our partnership with Ghorwane reinforces our commitment to Mozambican music and to what distinguishes us as a people,” he added.

During the conference, Roberto Chitsonzo recalled the group’s journey, formed in the 1980s and known for its distinctive style and strong social consciousness. He also highlighted the symbolism of the name Ghorwane, inspired by a lake in the Chibuto district of Gaza province, “a lake that never dries,” just like the band’s legacy.

Carlos Gove, in turn, emphasised generational continuity: “This energy of 42 years is supported by young people to whom we have passed on our legacy. (…) Continue reading on the website Clubofmozambique.com

📝No encontro, foram dados repasses sobre a reunião dos articuladores com as Instituições de Justiça que aconteceu em Governador Valadares (MG) no dia 29 de maio, além de uma formação sobre o Anexo 8, firmado no acordo de Repactuação do caso rio Doce, que trata sobre a Saúde no âmbito reparatório. Aurora boreal 📷Nikon 5300📍Parque Nacional Connemara Irlanda 🇮🇪 

El viernes 10 de mayo de 2024, Irlanda fue testigo de un evento único de auroras boreales debido a una intensa tormenta geomagnética. Esta tormenta fue impulsada por varias eyecciones de masa coronal (CME) del Sol, lo que resultó en una actividad auroral extraordinaria que permitió ver las luces del norte mucho más al sur de lo habitual. ♥️

Las condiciones en Irlanda fueron ideales para observar este fenómeno, con cielos despejados y una gran cantidad de partículas solares interactuando con la atmósfera terrestre. En este evento se pude presenciar las impresionantes luces verdes y rojas en el cielo nocturno. ✨

Northern Lights 📷Nikon 5300📍Connemara National Park Ireland 🇮🇪 

 On Friday 10 May 2024, Ireland witnessed a unique Northern Lights event due to an intense geomagnetic storm.  This storm was driven by several coronal mass ejections (CMEs) from the Sun, resulting in extraordinary auroral activity that allowed the Northern Lights to be seen much further south than usual. ♥️

 The conditions in Ireland were ideal to observe this phenomenon, with clear skies and a large number of solar particles interacting with the Earth's atmosphere.  At this event you could witness the impressive green and red lights in the night sky. ✨

description:
Em entrevista para Loudwire, Zacky V falou sobre o álbum Life is but a Dream:

“Sinto que muitas bandas pensam: ‘Ok, vamos fazer um disco que vai deixar todo mundo feliz. Nós pensamos, não! Temos que estar dispostos a perder tudo o que construímos nos últimos 20 e poucos anos, temos que estar dispostos a arriscar tudo pela emoção que nos trouxe a fazer isso em primeiro lugar. Escreva o álbum que você quer fazer, coloque a arte do jeito que você quer fazer. Esteja disposto a perder sua casa. Esteja disposto a recomeçar para fazer algo que você ama. E se você não está disposto a fazer isso, não será capaz de criar algo que seja verdadeiro para si mesmo e verdadeiro em seu coração. Você está apenas seguindo os movimentos. Nós sempre tratamos cada disco como se fosse a coisa mais importante do mundo. Fizemos isso em todos os álbuns, você tem que lutar para ficar fora de sua zona de conforto. Não há dúvida de que Life Is But a Dream existe fora da zona de conforto da banda, o que é bom porque é exatamente o que estávamos tentando fazer. Algumas pessoas não entendem hoje, outras vão entender mais tarde. E isso não me importa, é o que nós queríamos fazer... Estou muito orgulhoso da minha banda porque sempre tivemos a mesma mentalidade de ser a banda que lançou Warmness on the Soul quando tínhamos 17 anos. Eu e M. Shadows colocamos uma balada de piano em cima de um álbum de black metal, punk rock e metalcore. Naquele momento, todos na cena hardcore nos odiavam e não entendiam e queriam lutar contra nós porque estávamos obliterando a santidade do hardcore. O instinto natural é jogar pelo seguro, é aí que a natureza humana intervém e diz: Não sei se podemos fazer isso. Mas é onde nos sentimos mais vivos. Eu sei que nem todos vão gostar do álbum. Mesmo se nós fizéssemos um Nightmare ou Hail To The King 2.0 teriam pessoas que não gostar. Então iríamos fazer mais do mesmo ou algo com todo nosso coração e alma? Não existe nada mais gratificante que isso.”

Sep 30, 2004 -  St.-Sgt. Victor Ariel, 20, of Kadima, a medic in the Shimshon Battalion, was killed by a grenade thrown by a Hamas terrorist as he ran to treat Shulamit Batito, whom  terrorists shot dead as she was jogging near her home in Nissanit in the Gaza Strip.

A devoted student of karate since the fourth grade, Ariel eventually became an instructor who taught an entire generation of children on his moshav.

"It's always the good ones who go, and you always hear about the 'flowers' that were cut off in their prime," recalled Moshiko, a childhood friend. "And it's so painful to say this about someone you grew up with -- but Victor really was a flower. If I had to think about someone who contributed to the community, that's Victor. For whole summers long, when everyone was on vacation, he'd come and train the kids in karate. He virtually raised the next generation on Kadima."

description:
What drives kids to read? Researchers identified seven categories of reading motivation: 

– Curiosity (interest in learning)
– Involvement (enjoyment of stories)
– Recognition (praise for reading)
– Grades (academic reward)
– Competition (outperforming others)
– Compliance (reading because it’s required)
– Work Avoidance (avoiding reading effort)

Curiosity and involvement—both intrinsic—are most closely linked to stronger reading habits and comprehension.

Source: Schiefele, U., Schaffner, E., Möller, J., & Wigfield, A. (2012). Dimensions of reading motivation and their relation to reading behavior and competence. Reading Research Quarterly, 47(4), 427–463. https://doi.org/10.1002/RRQ.030

description:
Siempre soñé con tener un espacio donde poder ayudar a más mujeres.
Mujeres con tanto que ofrecer…
Con ideas, corazón, intuición, ganas.
Pero con pocas posibilidades financieras.
Como yo, al inicio.

Porque sí —yo tampoco pude pagarme un programa costoso cuando empecé.
Y sé lo que duele tener el alma encendida pero sentir que las puertas no se abren.

Por eso nació MAPE.
Para darte acceso.
Para darte dirección.
Para que no sigas sintiéndote sola ni perdida.

Hoy MAPE renace.
Más clara. Más práctica. Más espiritual.
Y pensada para ti.

Si sientes que esto podría ser para ti, escríbeme “MAPE” y agendamos una sesión estratégica gratuita.
En esa llamada, yo o alguien de mi equipo te ayudaremos a saber si este espacio es lo que realmente necesitas ahora.
Sin presión. Solo desde el corazón.

Porque tú también tienes derecho a empezar.
Y yo estoy aquí para ayudarte a hacerlo bien.

Mañana te lo cuento todo.

“El club mensual de mujeres con alma emprendedora”.
Con rituales grupales, reconocimientos, retos simples…  Vente con nosotras 🙏🏽 todas somos una.

لاک ژل از اوایل دهه ۲۰۰۰ رایج شده و با نور فرابنفش یا ال‌ای‌دی سفت و ماندگار می‌شود.

‘Go play!’ isn’t working? Here’s what to say instead for more independent play. 

These 5 phrases encourage freedom, ownership, trust, and a growth mindset:
	1.	“I love how you figured that out on your own!” – Builds problem-solving and a growth mindset.
	2.	“You’re the boss of your playtime—what will you do next?” – Gives them control and ownership.
	3.	“You GET to choose how you want to play.” – Encourages excitement and decision-making.
	4.	“I see you’re working hard on that. Tell me about it later!” – Shows trust and interest while giving space.
	5.	“I trust you to try it your way.” – Strengthens resilience and independence.

These are worth remembering—hit save so you can try them this week and share it with a parent friend who’s tired of saying ‘Go play!’

description:
Pornography disrupts the mental well-being of anyone who consumes it.

Especially children.

Why?

Because pornography is what neurologists call a supernormal stimulus. 

It overpowers our will and leaves a mark on our brain. Especially on those amazing child brains 🧠 

I’ve counseled men and women for years who have struggled with unwanted porn use. 

And they all have one thing in common: they all remember the first image they saw. Because like yellow mustard on a white shirt, no matter how hard you scrub, it leaves a stain. 
 
This is why we believe in:
 
1️⃣ Normalizing the word. Pornography. Say it. Often. When? As soon as possible. Check our “P*rn” Story Highlight and read, “How to Talk to a 5-Year-Old” about porn.
 
2️⃣ Avoiding unnecessary risk. Quit giving kids smartphones (@savethekidsinc). If a 13-year-old misuses an iPhone, my first thought is, “That’s not your fault. We did that.” Stick with devices made for kids LIKE GABB (@gabbwireless) – use their watch or phone (if you buy a Gabb use “PYE” at checkout). Or more options with a @barktechnologies phone (DM me for details!). 
 
3️⃣ Proactively preparing for “the fall.” Remind your kids that they can always land safely with you. Say it so often they finish your sentences and roll their eyes when you say it. “Good, just wanted to make sure. Because I love you so much.”

You cannot delegate digital wellness. No toggle, switch, or book replaces YOU! And I believe you have digital superpowers 🙌🏼

Parenting with you!
Chris

Hoje, dia 07, foi um excelente dia para a educação do Paraná! 📚

Estive no distrito do Guará, em Guarapuava, participando da entrega de kits escolares para os alunos do ensino fundamental II e médio do Colégio Estadual do Campo Professora Maria de Jesus Pacheco Guimarães. 🏫📚

O evento contou com a presença do deputado federal Rodrigo Estacho, do chefe do Núcleo Regional de Educação de Guarapuava, Marlon Douglas Pires, e do diretor do colégio, Luiz Alberto Ogibowski. Juntos, celebramos mais uma conquista para nossos estudantes! 

Esses kits incluem tudo o que os alunos precisam para começar o ano letivo de 2025 com o pé direito: cadernos, lápis de cor, canetas, réguas, borrachas, apontadores com depósito e muito mais. Tudo isso foi possível graças ao esforço do Governo do Estado, em parceria com a Secretaria de Educação (Seed) e o Fundepar. 🖍️✏️

💰 O investimento ultrapassa R$ 40 milhões, garantindo a compra de 945 mil kits escolares com recursos próprios do Estado para toda a rede estadual de ensino, desde o 6º ano até o EJA e cursos técnicos. Essa iniciativa representa um alívio para o orçamento de muitas famílias, especialmente aquelas com mais de um filho, e é um incentivo importante para os estudos.

Nosso agradecimento ao governador Ratinho Júnior, que está fazendo história na educação do Paraná! Esses kits farão toda a diferença para nossos estudantes e suas famílias.

The Tecnomar for Lamborghini 63 is a 63-foot carbon fibre yacht that fuses Lamborghini's iconic design with high-performance engineering. Powered by twin MAN V12 engines, together delivering 4,000 horsepower for a top speed of 63 knots. Inspired by classic Lamborghini models like the Miura and Countach, her aggressive silhouette, aerodynamic hardtop, and distinctive bow lights redefine nautical aesthetics, while the interior features hexagonal motifs, advanced materials, and full customisation through the Ad Personam program. The pilot cabin mirrors a Lamborghini cockpit with supersport seats, carbon fibre details, and the signature "start&stop" button, delivering a truly exhilarating on-water experience.⁠

description:
Una nuova puntata di 𝐫𝐞𝐏𝐋𝐀𝐘, la rubrica a cura di Arci Reggio Emilia e Gazzetta di Reggio dedicata alla scena musicale del territorio 🎸

Due volte al mese vi presentiamo una nuova band o un musicista e oggi parliamo di 𝐒𝐞𝐥𝐞𝐧𝐞 🎙

Un genere, quello della giovane cantautrice, che mescola R&B, dark pop e cynematic, ma sono i testi, «di cui scrivo ogni singola parola», come afferma lei stessa, ciò che per lei conta di più della sua musica.

Quello che voglio trasmettere è un sentimento di rivincita meritata di quando comprendi che concederti ciò che meriti dipende solo da te e che è il momento di volerlo davvero una volta per tutte.

Scopri l’articolo completo sulla Gazzetta del 29 aprile e sulla versione digitale del quotidiano 📰

Manaus/AM - As consequências decorrentes da forte chuva que atingiu Manaus neste sábado (15), causando sérios alagamentos, foram sentidas, também, na comunidade Santa Marta, localizada na zona norte da cidade, na Colônia Terra Nova. A enchente deixou as ruas completamente submersas, e a água chegou a níveis alarmantes, quase alcançando os telhados das casas. Moradores ficaram ilhados e improvisaram resgates com uma caixa d’água usada como bote.
Além disso, o impacto da chuva foi sentido em outras áreas da Colônia Terra Nova, como na Avenida Passarinho, onde as ruas foram transformadas em verdadeiros rios. Casas foram invadidas pela água, gerando preocupação entre as famílias, que enfrentam dificuldades para proteger seus pertences.

🥺Am I pretty enough yet?
⠀
⠀
Here’s the thing about constantly focusing on how you goal with health & wellness.
⠀
⠀
And I’m not saying it’s bad to want to look like a snack, but if you only judge on how you look, your results over the long term, will be in trouble.
⠀
⠀
It just leads to more insecurities as you identify more and more with how you look.
⠀
⠀
And aging isn’t slowing down for anybody!
⠀
⠀
Usually, this leads to rather poor health because our decisions that are solely based on our aesthetics can often be unhealthy for us.
⠀
⠀
❌Overtraining
❌Extreme dieting
❌Taking all supplements under the sun
⠀
⠀
Ironically, this all leads to poor health & not so sexy aesthetics.
⠀
⠀
When it comes to optimal health, you’re path is predictable.
⠀
⠀
Your journey leads to massive confidence as you stop solely identifying with how you look and instead identify with personal growth & wellness.
⠀
⠀
The kicker? Your looks benefit as a byproduct of seeking optimal health.
⠀
⠀
Thriving as a healthy individual, mentally & physically, looks damn good.
⠀
Take a moment to envision what you would look like in a state of optimal health.
⠀
You will most likely have some lean muscle, performing at a high level, radiating positive vibes & baby clear skin.
⠀
⠀
Chasing aesthetics is cool, but thriving optimally is much, much cooler.
⠀
⠀

🔎 PROJETO LUPA 🔎 Você sabia que a floresta do Jardim Botânico faz parte de uma Unidade de conservação?🌳

Desde 2018, a área de vegetação nativa do Jardim Botânico é reconhecida como Refúgio da Vida Silvestre (RVS) - Aimorés, uma UC essencial para proteger o Cerrado paulista. 🐾

Essa é uma área valiosa para a biodiversidade, por isso a instituição adota regras específicas de visitação, garantindo o respeito à natureza e aos seres que ali vivem. 🐜🦋

🚀 Conectando jovens ao futuro! A startup amazonense Trilha do Aprendiz acaba de fechar mais uma parceria de impacto! Agora, em colaboração com o Tribunal de Justiça do Pará (TJ-PA), a startup passa a atuar no Programa Novos Caminhos, que promove a inclusão de adolescentes e egressos das unidades de acolhimento no mercado de trabalho. 💼✨

📌 A Trilha do Aprendiz facilitará a contratação de jovens aprendizes, garantindo total conformidade com a Lei da Aprendizagem (Lei 10.097/2000). O compromisso é oferecer capacitação, suporte e conexão com empresas, gerando oportunidades reais para quem mais precisa! 🙌

🗺️ Um dos destaques dessa parceria é a implantação do "Mapa do Jovem Trabalhador", uma ferramenta inovadora que mapeia perfis de candidatos e conecta suas habilidades às necessidades das empresas contratantes. 

“O Mapa alinha as habilidades dos jovens com as demandas das empresas, conectando-os de forma eficiente ao mercado”, destaca Helen Araújo, diretora jurídica da startup. 🏆📊

💡 Desde outubro do ano passado, a Trilha do Aprendiz já atua no Amazonas, em parceria com a Coordenadoria da Infância e da Juventude do TJAM, fortalecendo ainda mais o impacto do programa na região. Agora, com a expansão para o Pará, mais jovens terão acesso a oportunidades de desenvolvimento e crescimento profissional! 🌎🔝

Enjoy your Labor Day weekend without falling off the wagon 

Here are some tips to stay on track with your weight and wellness goals: 

💥 Make veggies a part of the spread. Grilled vegetables are a delicious and healthy side, or throw together a nice salad.
💥 Be sure to eat before the barbeque! Don't "save your appetite". That'll only lead to you overeating.
💥 Thirst is often disguised as hunger. So as usual, hydrate properly. Especially if you like to have a few drinks like I do.
💥 If you are a sweets addict like myself, don't overdo it. It will only make the following week really difficult as you battle cravings again.
💥 Make yourself a balanced plate. As much as we want to jump straight to the Mac, make sure you throw in some protein, and veggies.
💥 Enjoy yourself! Food is meant to be enjoyed and bonded over also. So don't stress yourself too much.

Polisi tengah mendalami dugaan kasus kepemilikan senjata api (senpi) ilegal milik anak bos Prodia, Arif Nugroho. Hingga kini, proses penyidikannya masih berjalan.

"Ada (laporan kepemilikan senpi ilegal), masih jalan. Sudah sidik," ujar Dirreskrimum Polda Metro Jaya, Kombes Wira Satya pada wartawan, Senin (10/2/2025).

Menurutnya, proses penanganan laporan tentang dugaan kasus kepemilikan senpi ilegal milik tersangka dugaan kasus pemerkosaan dan pembubuhan remaja perempuan inisial FA, Arif Nugroho masih berjalan. Polisi pun bakal menyampaikan perkembangan penyidikan kasus tersebut ke depannya.

"Nanti kita buka lagi berkasnya. Pokoknya prosesur berjalan," tuturnya

Sementara Anggota Kompolnas, Choirul Anam mengatakan, sejatinya ada tiga laporan polisi (LP) dalam peristiwa kematian remaja perempuan inisial FA dengan tersangka Arif Nugroho dan Muhammad Bayu Hartanto.

Volta às aulas em Curitiba!

Nesta quarta-feira (12/2), o prefeito Eduardo Pimentel e o secretário Jean Pierre Neto recepcionaram os estudantes e suas famílias na Escola Municipal Prefeito Omar Sabbag, no bairro Cajuru, marcando o início do ano letivo na rede municipal!

A escola passou por melhorias, incluindo um novo piso na quadra esportiva, e preparou uma recepção especial para os alunos.

A Setran também esteve presente para garantir um trânsito mais seguro nesse retorno às aulas!

A Prefeitura segue investindo em reformas, contratações e melhorias para garantir um ambiente de aprendizado de qualidade para as crianças.

A terceira temporada de “Encantado’s” estreia no dia 29 de abril na TV Globo, trazendo novas histórias e desafios para os personagens da série. Desta vez, Olímpia (Vilma Melo) viverá um dilema amoroso ao conhecer Walter (Paulo Lessa), um contador pragmático e apaixonado.

Criada por Renata Andrade e Thais Pontes, e escrita em parceria com Chico Mattoso, Antonio Prata e Hela Santana, a nova temporada acompanha os preparativos da G.R.E.S. Joia do Encantado para um desfile emocionante em homenagem a Geraldo Ponza. Enquanto Eraldo (Luis Miranda) lida com a pressão de honrar o legado do pai, Olímpia enfrenta mudanças em sua vida pessoal. Com direção artística de Henrique Sauer, a temporada foi desenvolvida diretamente para a TV aberta, com exibição posterior no Globoplay.

O elenco conta com Augusto Madeira, Ludmillah Anjos, Dhu Moraes, Neusa Borges, Dandara Mariana, Evelyn Castro, João Côrtes, Dhonata Augusto, Digão Ribeiro e Leandro Ramos.

Today we are looking at the legendary field recording work of Alan Lomax. We released a mini-doc just yesterday, and if you want to learn more about arguably the most influential family in folk music history, give it a watch at the link in our bio. Here in this carousel we’ve included just a taste of the overwhelmingly beautiful archive that Alan Lomax captured throughout his life. If you want to dig deeper into said archive, and we strongly recommend that you do, explore the “Lomax Film Collection” channel on Youtube. You won’t regret it.

(2) Sam Chatmon - “Make Me A Pallet On The Floor” (1978)

(5) Nimrod Workman - “Oh Death” (1983)
(6) Sheila Kay Adams - “Little Margaret” (1982)
(7) Dock Boggs - “Pretty Polly” (1966)

description:
Junio comienza con el Sol brillando en el signo de Géminis, signo que nos trae la curiosidad, las ganas de aprender algo nuevo, nos da la posibilidad de mostrarnos más flexibles y adaptarnos con más facilidad a los procesos de la vida, nos mostramos más extrovertidos y alegres.
Mercurio que es el regente de Géminis, está en su signo, y esto hace que nuestra mente esté bien activa, muchos pensamientos randoms, quizás un toque de ansiedad nos gobierne y haga que entre tanta mente, nuestra comunicación también este bien rápida y activa. Entre el Sol y Mercurio que están en el mismo signo, hay una conjunción, y esto remarca el brillo en la comunicación, en el encuentro con el otrx, en las charlas, en los proyectos, en las risas y en juntarse a aprender algo nuevo, alimentar nuestro mundo sociocultural a full.
El mes comienza con la Luna transitando por Leo, ganas de disfrutar y disfrutar- me, de darme amor y pasarla bien, de mostrarme y permitirme ser especial, como ya lo somos. La Luna está en conjunción con Marte en Leo, y este combi es explosiva, una bomba de emoción. Quizás sea un lindo momento para ponerle zoom a todos los logros y todos los destaques que me hacen ser yo, y celebrarnos.

A trabajar por lo que querés y poner en acciones todo lo que venís laburando, suelto lo que ya aprendí y me meto de lleno a los nuevos desafíos que me van a llevar a mi versión 2.0, esa que me hace sentir orgullosx y zarpadx.
Saturno en Aries está en conjunción Neptuno en Aries, y esto exalta este empuje hacia mis deseos, mis sueños, pero de manera objetiva, hay que poner disciplina en unx mismx para nuestras más grandes conquistas 🧙🏽‍♀️

Transformar um quarto para quatro irmãos (pequenos) em um espaço funcional e estiloso foi um desafio que acabou resultando em um projeto incrível! 

Neste quarto, optamos por 2 camas beliches que fazem parte de uma mesma marcenaria planejada, maximizando o espaço e proporcionando conforto para os meninos. 

As 4 camas possuem iluminação indireta própria e cortina, trazendo assim privacidade.

As cores em tons de azul trazem frescor e tranquilidade, criando um ambiente acolhedor.

Além disso, incluímos um closet com iluminação embutida na marcenaria, que não só organiza os pertences, mas também dá um toque moderno e prático ao espaço. Essa iluminação destaca os detalhes da madeira e torna a experiência de se vestir mais divertida.

Um projeto pensado para atender às necessidades de quatro irmãos, promovendo a convivência e a harmonia! 🥰👷🏽‍♀️ #isabellabaetaarquiteta

description:
운동을 시작한 이유?
웨스트포인트(미육사) 제대하고 갓 임관한 의욕충만 헬창 소위의 
눈에 띈 60kg 초반 말라깽이 이등병이 나였음 ㅋ
포천으로 첫 훈련 가는데 바로 자기 험비에 타라고 하더니 
훈련장 도착하자마자 험비에서 덤벨을 꺼냄 ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
암튼 그렇게 Road to 헬창이 시작 됨
영어 잘 못하고, 토익 턱걸이해서 들어간 카투사인데
운동 열심히 하니까 미군들이 신기했는지 먼저 보충제도 챙겨주고, 
같이 놀자고 하고 이래저래 챙겨주길래 더 신나서 운동했던거 같다.
나중엔 미2사단 전투부대인데, 대대 PT 1등까지 해버렸다. 
저 사람 아니었으면 난 아직 건설사 직원에, 
지금 중동 어딘가에 일하는 중이었을지도 모른다.

.
“What is a river but an open throat; what is water but a voice”
.
As a huge fan of This is How You Lose the Time War! I was very excited to see that @amalelmohtar had a new book coming out The River Has Roots!
.
I am currently reading it! And the iconic Robin @cozyinthenook advised me to also listen to the audiobook, and it was the best decision. I’ve been reading the book with the audio playing and it’s made the story even more immersive. 
.
Loving it so far and the writing is oh so poetic. Looking forward to seeing where the story goes!

description:
Back in 2015, I had the incredible opportunity to cover Pope Francis’ visit to the Philippines. Seeing the overwhelming faith and devotion of millions was truly humbling. It was more than just a news assignment—it was a deeply moving experience.

Last year, my family and I were privileged to meet Pope Francis in Italy. To be in his presence is a gift and a reminder for us to remain humble and empathic towards others. 

I will forever be grateful for these experiences that have deepened my faith and strengthened my commitment to share love and light wherever I go. 

Pope Francis, your kindness, humility, and unwavering faith lit the way for so many. Rest in God’s eternal embrace. #PopeFrancis

Carro colide com poste em Guaramirim e deixa quatro jovens feridos. Foi na noite de domingo, 21, por volta das 22h10, na BR 280, no Centro, quando um carro com quatro jovens colidiu contra um poste. Eles foram socorridos pelos bombeiros e Samu e encaminhados para hospitais da região. Uma passageira de 20 anos, que estava no banco traseiro, foi levada ao Hospital São José, em Jaraguá do Sul, com dores abdominais, inchaço localizado e suspeita de hemorragia interna. Outra passageira, de 24 anos, também no banco traseiro, foi socorrida ao Hospital Santo Antônio, em Guaramirim, apresentando sintomas graves, como dor abdominal, palidez, falta de ar, batimentos cardíacos acelerados, pressão baixa, suspeita de fratura nas costelas e sinais de hemorragia interna. O passageiro do banco da frente, um jovem de 23 anos, foi levado ao Hospital São José com dores abdominais e inchaço. Já o motorista, de 24 anos, foi encaminhado ao Hospital Santo Antônio com dores abdominais, inchaço, sangramento nasal e suspeita de fratura nos dedos do pé direito.

description:
Project Orion wasn’t your regular rocket idea instead of burning fuel, it planned to use nuclear bombs for thrust. How? A giant metal plate would sit at the back of the spacecraft. Small nuclear explosions would be set off behind it, each blast pushing the plate forward and propelling the rocket into space. This method, called nuclear pulse propulsion, could theoretically reach Mars in weeks and even travel to other stars within a human lifetime.
The idea was tested on paper in the 1960s, but banned because of nuclear test treaties and safety risks. Still, it remains one of the boldest concepts in rocket history a machine powered not by fire, but by controlled nuclear fury.

description:
Playing Guitar or any physical activity is humbling on the level that its not 'You' who does it. Its the body, we throw instructions at the body and 'expect' it to memorise them. And that's not even enough sometimes, we expect our body's to keep up with us when we want to improvise something or smash out that solo 1st take. 
We make hugely unreasonable requests and then when the body doesn't co-operate, we get angry with ourselves and our body, as if they are somehow separate. But there is no self that exists, its just consciousness arising from conditions of a body. The body is not separate from nature in terms of it has its own time, its own way of taking on information. It learns not from intellect and brute force, it learns from a felt sense of how things are. And slowly it changes. 
At the moment 'my' playing is falling apart, I'm doing a lot of learning of songs and teaching. Which is great fun! but I'm not getting proper time to 'marinade' the practice, so as I 'speed learn' I end up programming rushed information into the system. Not helped by a rushing mind state that then attaches to that 'feeling' of playing.
No wonder so many musicians burn out mentally, they think its 'them' but really its a lack of respect for nature and the body. The actual felt reality of the body. So as I sit here procrastinating, worrying about filming 'Pantera Cowboys From Hell' for LickLibrary because my body and mind aren't in balance. I write this as a reminder to myself and all of us doing anything physical. The body is always right here, in the moment, it doesn't lie. Respect it! 

Dimebag had his body and its arising consciousness with its impressions from the world, his influences, his felt sense of being an embodied human. Nobody can re-create that 100%. Even Dimebag himself surely felt that his playing felt different from week to week. What an incredible musician he was!

LHOKSEUMAWE - Kepala Humas Rumah Sakit Umum Daerah Cut Meutia Aceh Utara, Harry Laksamana, mengatakan korban penyiraman air baterai, RNF berusia 13 tahun, harus menjalani operasi plastik. Hal ini karena 40 persen wajahnya melepuh.

“Untuk kondisi matanya tidak mengalami gangguan penglihatan, hanya saja kelopak matanya itu nanti ditangani oleh dokter bedah,” kata Harry kepada AJNN, Kamis, 17 Oktober 2024.

RNF saat ini menjalani perawatan di Rumah Sakit Umum Zaenoel Abidin, Banda Aceh. Wajahnya yang melepuh itu diduga disiram oleh ayah tirinya, di Desa Meunasah Blang, Kecamatan Muara Dua, Lhokseumawe.

Harry menjelaskan luka yang dialami korban berisiko infeksinya besar. Bahkan setelah operasi harus mendapatkan perawatan serius.

Selain itu, kata dia, korban juga diperlukan pendampingan perawatan psikologis. Ini supaya korban bisa menerima kejadian yang dialaminya dan fokus ke penyembuhan. 

“Karena pastinya korban mengalami trauma, sehingga kira menganjurkan kepada keluarga berobat dengan benar dalam hal fisik maupun psikologis,” imbuhnya 

Harry menjelaskan dalam perawatan korban penyiriman air baterai semua biaya ditanggung rumah sakit. Sedangkan semua fasilitas dari daerah ke ibu kota ditanggung Pemerintah Lhokseumawe.

Diberitakan sebelumnya, dua anak di bawah umur di Gampong Menasah Blang Kandang, Kecamatan Muara Dua, Kota Lhokseumawe menjadi korban penyiraman air baterai oleh orang tak dikenal. 

Korban merupakan adik kakak yakni berinisial AF (16) dan RNF (13). Akibat kejadian tersebut AF mengalami luka pada bagian lengan kiri dan kaki kanan, sedangkan adiknya mengalami luka pada bagian wajah, sebagian badannya dan kaki kiri. 

Berdasarkan informasi yang diperoleh, kejadian tersebut terjadi kemarin, Senin, 14 Oktober 2024 sekitar pukul 04.00 WIB saat keduanya masih dalam keadaan tertidur. 

Pelaku menyiram air baterai ke tubuh korban melalui jendela kamar korban. Saat ini pelaku sedang diburu polisi.

Pacientes com glaucoma em Ilhéus sofrem com falta de colírio na farmácia municipal

Pacientes que dependem do colírio para o tratamento do glaucoma enfrentam dificuldades para obter o medicamento na Farmácia Municipal de Ilhéus. A falta do remédio, distribuído gratuitamente, preocupa os pacientes, que temem perder a visão devido à interrupção do tratamento.

Na manhã desta terça-feira (25), diversos pacientes procuraram a farmácia municipal em busca do colírio, mas não conseguiram o medicamento. A Secretaria Municipal da Saúde foi informada sobre o problema e se comprometeu a solucioná-lo, mas não informou um prazo para a regularização do abastecimento.

O tratamento do glaucoma exige o uso contínuo do colírio para evitar o aumento da pressão ocular e a perda da visão. A interrupção do tratamento pode agravar o quadro clínico dos pacientes.

Diante da falta do medicamento na farmácia municipal, muitos pacientes estão comprando o colírio em farmácias particulares ou pela internet para evitar a progressão da doença. No entanto, o custo do medicamento pode ser um obstáculo para muitos pacientes.

description:
Mousse de Chocolate fácil, rápido e saboroso 🍫

- Ingredientes:
300 gramas de chocolate meio amargo
1 lata de creme de leite sem soro
395g de leite condensado fake ( está nos meus destaques ) 

- Modo de Preparo:
Quebre o chocolate em pedaços. Coloque em uma tigela de vidro ou cerâmica e derreta no microondas - 30 segundos em potência alta e mexa. Mais 30 segundos e mexa, e assim até que esteja totalmente derretido.

Despeje em outra tigela e acrescente o creme de leite sem o soro.
Misture bem e depois acrescente o leite condensado, aos poucos. Experimente para adequar ao seu gosto. Transfira para potes individuais e leve para a geladeira para gelar.

description:
מפקדים בכירים בחיזבאללה עברו ניתוחים קוסמטיים באיראן, במטרה להקשות על ישראל לזהות אותם, מחשש שיחוסלו. כך דיווחה רשת “אל-חדת’” הסעודית, כשעל פי הדיווח שלה, בין בכירי ההנהגה שעברו ניתוחים גם כאלו שלא נפצעו ב”מתקפת הביפרים” או בתקיפות חיל האוויר בלבנון, אך עשו זאת כ”צעד מונע”.

“עשרות ניתוחים קוסמטיים דחופים לחברי ולמפקדי חיזבאללה שנפצעו בתקיפות של כטב”מים ישראליים מתבצעים באיראן ובמרפאות סודיות בפיקוח משמרות המהפכה”, נטען בכתבה ששודרה בערוץ הסעודי וכללה ראיונות בפנים מוצללות של כמה ממחבלי חיזבאללה.

כשנה לאחר כניסת הפסקת האש בין ישראל לחיזבאללה בלבנון לתוקף, ארגון הטרור שמנהיגו המיתולוגי חסן נסראללה חוסל לפני יותר משנה, עדיין נמצא על הכוונת הישראלית ומדי יום מתבצעות תקיפות בשטח לבנון, בעיקר באמצעות חיל האוויר, כדי לאכוף את הפסקת האש, למנוע ניסיונות שיקום של תשתיות טרור וחיסול של מחבלים בכירים שפועלים להתעצמות מחודשת תוך הפרת ההסכם בין הצדדים.

למרות החלטה של ממשלת לבנון שקובעת כי על ארגון הטרור למסור את נשקו לצבא לבנון שהוא אמור להיות הגורם החמוש הבלעדי במדינה, האכיפה מתבצעת בעצלתיים. ישראל וארה”ב אינן מרוצות מכך ולאחרונה הגביר צה”ל את תקיפותיו נגד מטרות טרור של חיזבאללה וחיסולים של מפקדים בדרגי השטח, שפועלים כדי להציב איום מחודש על ישראל מצפון.

Officials deny Pakistani arms exports to Israel

Pakistani officials have denied reports that Pakistan exported 155mm shells or any kind of arms or ammunitions to Israel.

Speaking to Islamabad Insider, officials slammed dubious reports distributed on Indian media suggesting that Pakistan was secretly exporting arms to Israel.

A fake account on X also contributed to the dissemination of this fake news.

The object behind the misinformation operation, purportedly led by India is to show the world that Israel’s actions have Pakistan’s tacit approval.

This is because so far, Pakistan has dwarfed other Gulf states in its support for Gaza and has unequivocally expressed its support for the people of Palestine. 

Pakistan’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs has routinely condemned Israeli aggression in Gaza at every level, not sparing any forum to highlight Pakistan’s position on Palestine which is a two state solution alongside Al Quds Al Sharif as the capital of Palestine. 

Pakistan’s Chief of Army Staff, General Syed Asim Munir has on numerous occasions, reiterated Pakistan’s support for the Palestine cause.

HIGH QUALITY VEGAN PROTEIN SOURCES

What makes a protein high quality? Well for starters it has to actually be a “protein source”. To be a protein source the ingredient has to have protein as its highest macronutrient. So no beans aren’t a protein source, they’re a carb with protein. But, yes, tempeh is a protein source because its highest macronutrient is protein at a whopping 34g per cup! 

Swipe through for some of my favourite protein sources, most of which are easily accessible and gluten free! And if you’re not already make sure to follow me @evannryan for daily high protein vegan recipes and tips!

And I would love to know, what’s your favourite vegan protein source?

Mine is definitely tofu for its versatility💪🌱

description:
No próximo domingo, 14, será o Dia Mundial do Diabetes que tem o objetivo de conscientizar a população com foco nas diabetes mellitus. Porém, o que muitas pessoas talvez não saibam é que existem outros tipos de diabetes além da mellitus, como o exemplo do Diabetes Insipidus (DI), nosso tema do post de hoje!
 
O DI é um distúrbio que pode ser endócrino, genético ou adquirido devido a problemas na síntese do hormônio antidiurético (ADH), também chamado de vasopressina, responsável pelo equilíbrio de líquidos no nosso corpo. 

Um dos principais sintomas do DI é o excesso de sede que o indivíduo sente, chegando a beber mais de três litros de água por dia, além de apresentar um aumento considerável nos níveis de produção de urina, chamada de poliúria. 

O DI se divide em três tipos: Diabetes Insipidus Central ou Neurogênico (DIC), Diabetes Insipidus Gestacional (DIG), e Diabetes Insipidus Nefrogênico ou Renal (DIN), e suas causas estão relacionadas com cada tipo, e você pode saber mais passando pro lado. 

E é importante comentarmos que o DI não tem cura, mas os sintomas podem ser aliviados por meio de medicamentos que regulam o equilíbrio de líquidos e pelo controle dos líquidos ingeridos pelo paciente. 

Por fim, o Ministério da Saúde possui um documento abordando o “Protocolo Clínico e Diretrizes Terapêuticas do Diabete Insípido” que você pode acessar pelo nosso link da bio!

Comenta aqui nesse post se você já tinha ouvido falar do diabetes insipidus, e compartilha com os amigos nutris!

Stony grotto like forms and baroque cornice memories. My fingers work old forms that I have created but also add something new.

I found a note in my sketchbook that made sense of this:

“The forms in your life have to change, because you are changing”

I wonder if you resonate with that as well?

description:
A huge congratulations to Open Polytechnic ākonga (learner) Emily Morris, who has won a $100 grocery voucher thanks to @pathwaysawarua. 

Emily, who is studying towards a NZ Certificate in Computing (Foundation User) (Level 2), entered the competition by completing literacy and numeracy tasks on the Pathways Awarua learning website. 

Pathways Awarua is an external provider funded by the Tertiary Education Commission (TEC) that offers a digital platform to enhance ākonga (learner) literacy and numeracy skills. 

“I’m very happy and excited,” Emily says. 

“It’s a free way to improve my numeracy and literacy processes.” 

Open Polytechnic introduced it last year as an additional free resource to support literacy and numeracy development in our Level 2 IT courses, along with the option of individual support from one of our student mentors. 

Emily is studying IT as she looks to improve her computer knowledge and skills. 

“Everything is about computers now, so being involved and understanding about IT gives me confidence and empowers me to shape my future life given the advances in technology that are happening,” Emily says. 

“It is useful and practical in a modern world as it offers valuable skills, career stability and the ability to innovate” 

While she is currently working as a sewing machinist in Christchurch, Emily is hoping to change careers one day and become an IT professional in technical support or networking. 

“Having different types of job options both physical and computer type jobs is better than doing just doing a physical job,” she says. 

Learning flexibly online is “really good” in Emily’s situation, as she wants to keep earning money by working while learning. 

“I just can't thank Open Polytechnic enough, for letting me study as an adult learner, and giving me optional tools to look up and understand how to keep me growing in my study that will really help me in the future.”

To find out more about IT programmes go to our website (link in bio).

description:
Today, on Juneteenth, we commemorate the day in 1865 when the last enslaved African Americans in Texas were declared free—two and a half years after the Emancipation Proclamation. It is a day of truth-telling and remembrance. Archbishop Iakovos, who famously marched alongside Rev. Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. in Selma, once reflected: “I came to the United States because I chose to be in a country where I would not be a second-class citizen. Yet I soon discovered that there were citizens borne into this land who were treated as less than equal.” His witness reminds us that faith without justice is a contradiction, and that silence in the face of inequality is not an option for those who follow Christ.

As we remember the journey from slavery to emancipation, from exclusion to dignity, we must turn again to the Gospel’s call: “The Spirit of the Lord is upon Me… to proclaim liberty to the captives and recovery of sight to the blind, to set at liberty those who are oppressed” (Luke 4:18). Juneteenth is not merely about the past—it is a call to live in truth, and to build a more righteous society, one where the image of God is honored in every human being.

description:
We go again - RUN4GAZA will have a global day of action on 4th Feb as we aim to get 1000+ runners active in protest across the world, to call for a ceasefire and raise funds for the victims of the genocide.

This time we have our first run in Berkeley - it’s a 10am meet at Bartavelle Cafe on San Pablo and Cedar, and the finishing point will be at Heyma Yemeni Cafe on San Pablo and University. it’s a short social run or walk of approx 4-5km for all experience levels - the aim will be for the distance to be 4.1km to mirror the 41km length of the Gaza Strip.

please DM here or @iwannarunwithsomebodyrunclub to join or ask any questions

#ceasefirenow🇵🇸

বৈষম্য বিরোধী ছাত্র আন্দোলন ইউসেট কর্তৃক পরিষ্কার-পরিচ্ছন্ন কর্মসূচি 

সবুজে ঘেরা সোনার ফসল, ঝলমলানো নীল আকাশ, কাদামাটি, নদীর স্বচ্ছ পানি, সহজ সরল নিরহংকারী কৃষক ও মাঝি, আগুন রাঙা সূর্য, পূর্নিমা রাতের চাঁদের আলোয়, পাখির কলতানে ভরা, লতাপাতার নিবিড়তায় ঘেরা, এবং বনভূমির ছায়ায় ঘেরা এই বাংলার মতো আমাদের এই মনুষ্য হৃদয়কে সবুজ, সহজ, নদীর ওই স্বচ্ছ পানি, নিরহংকারী কৃষক আর মাঝি, এবং কাদামাটির ন্যায় গড়ে তুলতে হবে।
ঝলমলে ওই নীল আকাশের বিশালতার মতোই বিশাল বা উদার করে তুলতে হবে আমাদের এই মানব হৃদয়। 
তবেই আমাদের এই মনুষ্য হৃদয় পূর্নিমার চন্দ্রের আলোর ন্যায় আলোকিত হবে একদিন।
তবেই এই বাংলা আর বাংলার মানুষের, সাধারণ শিক্ষার্থীদের প্রকৃত অর্থে স্বাধীন এবং বিজয় হবে একদিন। আর আমি বা আমারা এবং সাধারণ ছাত্রছাত্রীরা সেই প্রচেষ্টাতেই আছি এবং এই প্রচেষ্টা জারি রেখে একদিন নিশ্চিত স্বাধীনতা এবং বিজয় অর্জন করবো ইনশাআল্লাহ।
সত্যের কাছে নত হয়ে, বিশ্ব ও জাতির কাছে উন্নত হবো মোরা
আত্মা আর বিবেককে জাগ্রত করে জ্ঞানের আলোয়,
দেশকে আলোকিত করবো এই আমরা।
স্রষ্টার নিকট এই কামনাই করছি, এবং আমাদের নিজেদের প্রতি নিজেরা এই প্রত্যাশাই রাখছি।

No sabemos comenzar con nosotros mismos. 

Han quedado tantos agujeros que ocupaba el otro, han desaparecido tantas maneras de ser para alguien más, que pensar en lo propio resulta muchas veces agobiante. 

Paradójicamente es el camino que puede producir algo distinto. Empezar contigo justo allí en los lugares en los que de ti te olvidaste. Empezar contigo para existir más allá de lo que se perdió.

description:
The smell of suncreen, falling sleep on a boat while it’s rocking you, salty skin, the feeling of water in your ear, being sunburnt so bad it hurts when your clothes touch your skin, pink and orange cumulonimbus clouds lighting up a sunset sky, ripe mangoes, lush green everywhere. 

I had always wondered why visiting tropical climates like Tahiti and Hawaii felt so insanely familiar to me, as if I was home but thousands of miles away.. turns outs, it’s simply because I was home. 

The mountains and desert sure do intrigue me, but the ocean will forever be home. Leaving Florida with a heart that’s overflowed to say the least <3

"I know not everyone loves milk as I do. Some can’t drink milk. Won’t drink milk. Don’t drink milk for physical or religious or philosophical reasons. And that’s fine, as adults. ⁠
⁠
It’s believed three-quarters of the world’s people get a ­substantial nutritional benefit from the milk of species not our own. This can seem odd at a time when we’re told that cows are causing ­climate change, that we don’t need a diet ­containing animal products to have complete nutrition, and that plant-based eating has the lowest footprint on Mother Earth. ⁠
⁠
With so many new “milks” appearing on the market, my aim is to unpick what is good, and bad, and ­perhaps not yet widely known, about drinking the milk from humans and other animals."⁠
⁠

🌿ミヤマガンショウ

🌿リトルジェム
常緑中木
タイサンボクの矮性種で、夏の暑さにも抜群に強く。
光沢のある葉っぱと、シックな葉裏がカッコ良い品種。
花が四季咲き性なので、春と秋にも咲きます。
花も綺麗で、香りも良く楽しめます。
ケイパレスも良く似た特徴があります。

🌿ティーツリー
常緑高木
オーストラリア原産の樹木が、近年日本では人気が出てきてます。
雪の様なフワフワの花と、アロマの原料にも使われる程、葉っぱの香りが物凄く良いです。
切り花としても、家の中で楽しめるのも魅力。
✔️植栽の注意点は、成長は早いので広い場所に植える事❗️

*Nota de prensa*

*IDOPPRIL y sector sindical trabajan conjuntamente por prevención de accidentes*

_Doctor Agustín Burgos preocupado por la clase laboral dominicana; insta a los afiliados a prevenir ante cualquier_ situación.

Santo Domingo. – El director ejecutivo del Instituto Dominicano de Prevención y Protección de Riesgos Laborales (IDOPPRIL), doctor Agustín Burgos, sostuvo un encuentro con representantes de los trabajadores, a fin de coordinar acciones en favor de ese segmento productivo.

El funcionario se reunió en la sede de la institución con los sindicalistas Gabriel del Río, Rafael (Pepe) Abreu y el diputado Jacobo Ramos.

Allí les manifestó su preocupación por la clase laboral dominicana. Exhortó a los afiliados a priorizar la prevención en el trayecto a sus centros de trabajo y en el ejercicio de sus tareas.

Compartió con los representantes del sector laboral el deseo de estos en lograr acuerdos interinstitucionales para crear estaciones de descanso en las carreteras. Las mismas servirían para que los trabajadores conductores puedan detenerse para reponer energías en espacios seguros.

“Creemos en que hay que dar, no solamente, la educación, sino mezclarla también con lo que tú les aportas para evitar los accidentes”, declaró.

Igualmente, les se refirió su interés de implementar programas que impacten la salud mental de la empleomanía nacional, especialmente, con los trabajadores lesionados permanentemente. 

También resaltó su compromiso de garantizar los derechos de los afiliados. El doctor Burgos solicitó la colaboración de los representantes de los trabajadores en este sentido.

De su lado, Gabriel del Río, representante de la Confederación Autónoma Sindical Clasistas (CASC), coincidió con el doctor Burgos en la necesidad de crear una cultura de prevención. Destacó como una meta fundamental evitar los accidentes de trabajo. Recordó que cada año realizan el Congreso de Riesgos Laborales, del cual el IDOPPRIL es parte importante.
